title: Grak's Village
text: Grak awakes, and he sees the destruction. Roofs have caved in, and smoke rises all around.

title: Searching for survivors
text: Grak calls for his kin. He finds bodies, but no one answers.

title: Across the river
text: The next village is the same. Hoping to find something besides destruction, Grak heads toward the capital.

title: The Rotunda
text: The capital is mostly undamaged, but no one is to be found. Finally, Grak finds someone in the Rotunda.

title: Malgrath
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Keep your hands where I can see them, orc.

title: The invasion
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Dead, or fled, it's all the same. The guild torched the villages, then tried to capture the city.

title: The stoic dragon
speaker: GRAK
text: So you killed them? I thought you just cared about gold.

title: The first wave
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Enough to make the rest retreat. I could barely get back down the stairs.

title: Another attack
speaker: MALGRATH
text: A few are still in the city. They'll try again, and more will follow. I cannot fight like that again.

title: The entrance
speaker: GRAK
text: Then we block the ways in. My people were skilled nomads and craftsmen. I can build defenses. I just need gold.

title: A hoard of generations
speaker: MALGRATH
text: You have a hammer. Use that.

title: The real cost
speaker: GRAK
text: Need timber. Iron. Weapons. Hammer won't buy those, greedy dragon.

title: An offer
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Take what is beside the steps. Leave the rest or I'll torch you.

title: The first defense
speaker: GRAK
text: I'll start upstairs. In the Rotunda.

title: The agreement
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Keep them there. I've had enough visitors down here.

title: Preparations
text: Grak takes the gold upstairs to fortify the Rotunda. The invaders still in town must pass through it to reach Malgrath.
